grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。
title: The Community Garden Committee Meeting
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习材料，适合B1–B2水平的学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。所有答案均基于录音内容。请仔细阅读每个问题，并在填空时注意字数限制。完成练习后，可参考词汇表和语法讲解进行复习。
transcript:
M: Good evening, everyone. Thanks for coming to the community garden meeting. I know it's late, but we have a lot to decide. First, let's talk about the budget for next season. We have 500 dollars from the local council, and we need to spend it wisely.

W: Sorry to interrupt, but didn't we get 600 dollars last year? I thought the council increased our grant.

M: No, that was two years ago. Last year we got 450 dollars. This year it's 500. So we have a little more than last year, but less than two years ago. Anyway, we need to allocate the money. I suggest we spend 200 dollars on new tools, 150 on seeds and plants, and the rest on compost and fertilizer.

W: That sounds reasonable. But what about the water bill? We still owe 80 dollars for last summer. If we don't pay it, the water company might cut us off.

M: Good point. I forgot about that. So let's take 80 dollars from the compost budget. That leaves 70 dollars for compost. Is that enough?

W: Probably. We can also ask members to bring kitchen waste for compost. That would save money.

M: Great idea. Now, about the schedule. We need to check our progress every month. Last year we only checked twice, and we had problems with the tomatoes. This year, I propose we have a monthly check on the first Saturday. Any objections?

W: No objections, but can we make it the second Saturday? The first Saturday is always busy for me.

M: OK, let's make it the second Saturday. Now, who will be responsible for the checks? We need someone to write a short report each month.

W: I can do that. I'm good at writing reports. But I'll need help with the photos. Maybe Tom can take photos?

M: Yes, Tom is good with cameras. I'll ask him. So, to summarize: budget is 500 dollars, we spend 200 on tools, 150 on seeds, 80 on the water bill, and 70 on compost. Monthly checks on the second Saturday, reports by you, photos by Tom. Any other business?

W: Just one thing. The shed needs painting. Can we use some of the money for that?

M: Hmm, we don't have extra money. But maybe we can ask for donations of paint. I'll put a notice on the community board. If we get paint, we can paint the shed next month.

W: OK. That sounds like a plan. Thanks, everyone.

questions.prompt: How much money does the garden receive from the council this year?
questions.explanation: 录音开头男士说“We have 500 dollars from the local council”，因此今年是500美元。600美元是两年前的金额，450美元是去年的金额。
questions.evidence: We have 500 dollars from the local council

questions.prompt: How much money will be spent on new tools?
questions.explanation: 男士建议“spend 200 dollars on new tools”，所以工具预算是200美元。
questions.evidence: I suggest we spend 200 dollars on new tools

questions.prompt: How much money do they still owe for the water bill? (Write a number and the word 'dollars'.)
questions.explanation: 女士提到“We still owe 80 dollars for last summer”，因此欠款是80美元。
questions.evidence: We still owe 80 dollars for last summer.

questions.prompt: When will they have their monthly check?
questions.explanation: 女士建议改到第二个星期六，男士同意“let's make it the second Saturday”，所以最终决定是第二个星期六。
questions.evidence: OK, let's make it the second Saturday.

questions.prompt: Who will write the monthly reports?
questions.explanation: 女士主动说“I can do that. I'm good at writing reports.”，因此由女士写报告。
questions.evidence: I can do that. I'm good at writing reports.

questions.explanation: 男士说“Tom is good with cameras. I'll ask him.”，结合上文女士请求Tom拍照，可知Tom将负责拍照。
questions.evidence: Maybe Tom can take photos? ... Yes, Tom is good with cameras. I'll ask him.

questions.prompt: How much money will be left for compost?
questions.explanation: 男士说从堆肥预算中拿出80美元付水费，原来堆肥预算是150美元，所以剩下70美元。
questions.evidence: So let's take 80 dollars from the compost budget. That leaves 70 dollars for compost.

questions.prompt: What does the woman suggest to save money on compost?
options: Ask members to bring kitchen waste
Ask the council for more money
answers: Ask members to bring kitchen waste
questions.explanation: 女士说“We can also ask members to bring kitchen waste for compost. That would save money.”，因此建议会员带来厨余垃圾做堆肥。
questions.evidence: We can also ask members to bring kitchen waste for compost. That would save money.

questions.prompt: How will they get paint for the shed?
questions.explanation: 男士说“maybe we can ask for donations of paint”，因此是通过捐赠获得油漆。
questions.evidence: But maybe we can ask for donations of paint.

questions.prompt: True or False or Not Given: The garden received 600 dollars from the council last year.
questions.explanation: 录音中男士明确说去年收到450美元，而不是600美元。600美元是两年前的金额。因此该陈述为False。

grammar.title: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接
grammar.explanation: 条件句用来表达“如果……就……”的意思，常见结构是“If + 主语 + 动词, 主语 + will/can + 动词”。数量词如 some, any, much, many, a little, a few 用来表示不确定的数量。段落间的指代与衔接是指用代词（如 it, they, this, that）或连接词（如 however, therefore, also）使段落连贯。
grammar.example: If we don't pay it, the water company might cut us off.

questions.prompt: If we ______ the water bill, the company might cut us off.
questions.explanation: 这是一个真实条件句，表示将来可能发生的情况，if从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词might。因此选“don't pay”。
questions.evidence: If we don't pay it, the water company might cut us off.

questions.prompt: We have ______ money this year than last year.
questions.explanation: money是不可数名词，比较级用a little more表示“多一点”。many和a few修饰可数名词，much more语气太强，不适合此处。
questions.evidence: So we have a little more than last year.

questions.prompt: We need someone to write a report. ______ can do that.
questions.explanation: 句子缺少主语，应该用主格代词I。Me是宾格，My和Mine是物主代词。

questions.prompt: The shed needs painting. ______, we don't have extra money.
questions.explanation: 前后句是转折关系：需要油漆，但是没有多余的钱。因此用However表示“然而”。
questions.evidence: The shed needs painting. ... However, we don't have extra money.

transfer.writing: You are a member of a local sports club. The club has a budget of 300 dollars for next month. Write a short proposal (about 120-150 words) to the club committee explaining how you would allocate the money. Include at least three expenses and give reasons for your choices. Use conditional sentences and quantity words where appropriate.
